column1: # DOCUMENT-KEYS — the key sets of the documents Folio keeps in its data folder, pinned per version
# A build reads a document at its own version and refuses one written at a higher version, so the
# keys a version holds must never change under it: a key added without a new version is dropped by
# the older builds of that version (or refused, by a record that refuses unknown keys), and its
# value is lost the next time they write. Two unbumped settings.json changes of 0.4.7 and 0.4.8
# One row per type a document's root reaches (the root, then the types its fields and its variants'
# payloads name, walked to a fixed point among its own crate's types), per version. Columns:
#   document  session, settings, keybindings, profiles, pins and update-check (bt-persist);
#   version   the document's version the row holds at (its *_SCHEMA_VERSION, or the record's)
#   shape     its declaration and body as bt_source reads them, squeezed: every // comment and all
#             whitespace out; the attributes (serde's among them), field and variant names and
# profile_marks::tests::the_integration_records_keep_their_keys hold each document's rows at its
# current version equal to the source, both ways. scripts/ci/check-document-keys.ps1 holds this
# file to the merge base's: a row is never edited or removed, and a new row's version is above its
# document's highest at the merge base.
# This file is append-only. A new key is admitted by bumping the document's version, adding its
# migration step (an identity step when the key has a serde default) and adding the new version's
# rows, every type of the document again, all in one commit, the rows' reason naming the plan row.
